sequenceReference.note: This is a further separately scoped package: it composes the existing CreateCustomerRequestHandler with a real CreateCustomerCommitService and the existing PostgresCommitAdapter, still with no HTTP/ASGI framework wired around any of it.

goal: Add the smallest framework-neutral composition factory that wires the existing CreateCustomerRequestHandler to a real CreateCustomerCommitService and the existing PostgresCommitAdapter, without adding any HTTP server, ASGI runtime, Uvicorn, Hypercorn, FastAPI, Django, app, release, deploy, or production claim.
nonGoals: no HTTP server of any kind
no Postgres, db or schema change
no CI, package.json or dependency change
no release, deploy, readiness or product-runnable claim
no change to src/adapters, src/application or src/domain
no app, module or release/deploy/publish path
no exposure of the composed adapter, service, pipeline, identity or policy decision point

red.note: Before src/delivery/create-customer-composition.mjs existed, every test importing it failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — a real capability gap, not an environment failure.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: the factory's option exactness, wiring order, returned-shape exactness, or the src/delivery ring materialization it proves drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert src/delivery/create-customer-composition.mjs, tests/kernel-create-customer-composition.test.mjs, the repository-boundary/substrate test updates, and this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: delivery-composition-and-tests-only; no adapters, application, domain, db or CI surface touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none: the factory performs no I/O beyond constructing a lazy PostgresCommitAdapter connection pool, and no test in this package opens a real database connection

userJourney.before: CreateCustomerRequestHandler ve CreateCustomerCommitService ayrı ayrı çalışabiliyordu ama ikisini ve gerçek PostgresCommitAdapter'ı tek bir çağrıda birbirine bağlayacak bir kompozisyon noktası yoktu; bir çağıranın bunları doğru sırayla elle bağlaması gerekiyordu.
userJourney.after: Artık createCustomerComposition({ connectionString, current, candidatesFor, evaluateInvariants }) tam olarak dört sıradan işbirlikçiyi alıp Identity, PolicyDecisionPoint, CreateCustomerPipeline, PostgresCommitAdapter, CreateCustomerCommitService ve CreateCustomerRequestHandler'ı doğru sırayla kuruyor ve donmuş { handler, close } döndürüyor. Hâlâ hiçbir HTTP sunucusu veya form gönderimi gerçekten çalışmıyor — bu paket yalnızca uygulama ile gerçek persistence adaptörü arasındaki tek bağlantı noktasını kanıtlıyor.
userJourney.note: Hiçbir sunucu, ASGI çalışma zamanı veya framework bu paketle çalışır hale gelmiyor; bu sadece framework-nötr bir kompozisyon köküdür.

kalanEngel: Hâlâ hiçbir HTTP/ASGI framework bu handler'ı dışarıya açmıyor; bu ayrı, henüz yetkilendirilmemiş bir paket kararı.

nextPackage.note: A future, separately scoped package may wire an actual HTTP/ASGI framework around this composition — out of this package's scope and non-goals.
preconditions: this package's targeted GREEN and npm run check both pass
a separate Codex MASTER-approved package scopes the delivery framework decision
